handback.t:
## Visual Quality + DS Compliance review of the web app (read-only, code-based)

I found 0 P0, 1 P1, 13 P2 and 7 P3 issues (21 in total, with repeated defects grouped into one finding each). The P1 is that the text is too small: one line in the base stylesheet shrinks every Tailwind text size. I made no changes to the repo; the only file written is the report.

Full report (findings with evidence, a per-page 3-second test with a loading/empty/error/disabled states matrix, a DS checklist and a fix order): C:[REDACTED:high_entropy].md

Paths are relative to `web/src`.

| # | Sev | Eff | Finding (evidence) | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | P1 | S | `html, body { font-size: 14px }` (styles/app.css:13-18) shrinks every rem-based Tailwind text size. `text-xs` becomes 10.5px (30 uses) and `text-sm` 12.25px (85 uses). This hits hashes, citations, audit hints, export errors (ExportMenu.tsx:95,99) and the demand letter (ClaimSheet.tsx:167). | Set 14px on `body` only, or pin a px text scale in `@theme` (12/13/14/16/20/24). |
| 2 | P2 | M | 55 colour utilities in 19 files reach tokens as `[var(--…)]`, because only the accent colours are registered in `@theme` (app.css:4-10). Example: `text-[var(--color-danger)]` x21. | Move the tokens into `@theme`, change these to classes like `text-danger` / `border-border`, and add a lint rule against `-[var(` and `-[#`. |
| 3 | P2 | M | Load errors show as plain body text with no retry on 10 sites plus 6 dev panels: ClaimSheet.tsx:276,351,393; ClaimIntelligenceTabs.tsx:35,84; IntelligencePage.tsx:71; ApiKeysPage.tsx:223,233; ReviewQueuePage.tsx:180; dev-common.tsx:12. The good pattern (card + danger colour + Try again) is at ClaimsPage.tsx:129-136. | Add `ErrorState({message, onRetry})` and `FormError` components. |
| 4 | P2 | S | The review queue has no loading state, so headers sit over an empty table body (ReviewQueuePage.tsx:83-118). | Add skeleton rows. |
| 5 | P2 | S | The toast store has a tone (info/success/error) but ToastRegion ignores it (ToastRegion.tsx:11-14), so "Assignment failed." looks the same as a success. | Style by tone; errors use `role=alert`. |
| 6 | P2 | S | Page titles vary: `text-xl` on 4 pages, `text-lg` on 3. The size ramp is flat: dialog and section titles are the same 14px as body (Dialog.tsx:27, ClaimSheet.tsx:56). | Define a type ramp and enforce it through a PageHeader component. |
| 7 | P2 | S | On Approvals, Approve is a neutral button and Reject is red, so the destructive choice has more weight. There can be up to 4 bordered buttons per row (ApprovalsPage.tsx:224-240). | Make Approve primary and Reject quiet, or use a single Review button per row. |
| 8 | P2 | S | Claim status always uses the neutral badge (ClaimsPage.tsx:182, ApprovalsPage.tsx:215, ClaimSheet.tsx:319), and API key status is plain text. | Add a `StatusBadge` with a tone map, keeping the text label. |
| 9 | P2 | M | There are no responsive breakpoints anywhere. The 224px sidebar is always shown (AppShell.tsx:126), and two tables have no scroll wrapper (IntelligencePage.tsx:80, ApiKeysPage.tsx:239). | Collapsible sidebar below `lg`, scroll-wrap all tables, and document a minimum supported width. |
| 10 | P2 | S | The "at least 10 characters" hint is missing on 2 of the 6 reason forms (ReviewQueuePage.tsx:297-301, 393-397), so their submit button stays disabled with no explanation. | Add a shared `ReasonField`. |
| 11 | P2 | M | About 30 copies of patterns that should be shared components, and they have already drifted. Pagination x4 (Intelligence uses a different order and alignment), Tabs x2, Menu x2, key/value rows x2 (160px vs 200px label width), page header x7 (mixed alignment), and the table card wrapper is used inconsistently. | Add 9 components to components/ui: Pagination, Tabs, Menu, DescriptionList, PageHeader, DataTableCard, ErrorState, ReasonField, StatusBadge. |
| 12 | P2 | S | Import page: the drop zone gives no feedback while dragging over it (ImportPage.tsx:175). Each file is listed twice (lines 196-207 and 219-253). The commit button has no busy label. | Add a drag-over style, move the progress bar into the table, show "Creating…" while busy. |
| 13 | P2 | S | The "Priority score" column shows a dollar amount and is left-aligned (IntelligencePage.tsx:83,102). | Rename it "Value at stake" and right-align it like other money columns. |
| 14 | P2 | S | In the review dialog each flagged field gets 3 buttons whose text repeats the field name (ReviewQueuePage.tsx:194-206). | Short visible labels; keep the field name in `aria-label`. |
| 15 | P3 | S | tokens.css says "8px grid", but the app actually runs on 4px steps (`gap-3` x40, `mb-3` x20, `p-3` x12). The component CSS uses raw px for buttons, inputs and badges. | Document the 4px scale and line up input and button padding. |
| 16 | P3 | S | The dark theme tokens are contrast-tested, but nothing sets `data-theme`, so they are never used. The QR code's hard-coded hex colours are an intentional exception but undocumented. | Wire up the dark theme or remove it; comment the QR exception. |
| 17 | P3 | S | `@theme` repeats the accent and font values from tokens.css. | Define them once. |
| 18 | P3 | S | Empty states are one-liners that don't separate "no data yet" from "no matches". A new tenant sees "No claims match these filters". | Add an `EmptyState` with a next-step button (Import / Create key / Clear filters). |
| 19 | P3 | S | Revoke in the API keys table is a neutral button (ApiKeysPage.tsx:263). The danger button style is red text only, which is weak for a final destructive confirm. | Add a solid danger button style. |
| 20 | P3 | S | The header shows "Ctrl K" on Mac too. The account button reads "Account menu" instead of the user's name. The sort targets are small. | Platform-specific shortcut label, show the user's name, enlarge the sort hit area. |
| 21 | P3 | S | 7 one-off layout values, including 3 different label-column widths for the same key/value pattern. | Fold into the DescriptionList component. |

**Things done well:**
1. **Contrast is tested in code.** `styles/contrast.test.ts` checks text colour pairs against WCAG AA in both themes.
2. **Shared CSS classes are used consistently.** `.btn`, `.input`, `.card`, `.badge-*` and `.data-table` appear everywhere. There are 0 inline styles and 0 raw hex colours in the components (apart from the QR code), plus sticky table headers, tabular numbers and right-aligned money columns. Buttons and inputs are the same height.
3. **The palette fits a finance tool.** Slate neutrals, one teal accent, sparing status colours and a 3-step shadow scale tinted toward the background.
4. **The Claims list is a model for page states.** Skeleton rows shaped like the table, no flash while filtering, an error card with retry, filters kept in the URL, and sortable headers marked for screen readers.
5. **One accessible Dialog component** (focus trap, Esc closes) is reused by about 10 dialogs, and there is a global focus outline in the accent colour.
6. **The Inter font is bundled with the app**, so there is no CDN or CSP exception. Animation timings are tokenised and respect reduced-motion settings.
7. **The copy builds trust.** "Draft for human review", "No email is sent from this app", and integrity/verifier badges with text labels.

Font check: Inter Variable is named in tokens.css:48 and app.css:5 and loaded in main.tsx:1, so it is available.

**Suggested fix order:**
1. #1, the one-line font-size fix.
2. #2 and #17, register the tokens and convert the 55 usages.
3. #11, the shared components; this also resolves #3, #4, #6, #8, #10, #18 and #21.
4. Page polish: #7, #5, #12, #13.
5. #9, the responsive layout.
